title: Conservatives want PM's wife Diana Fox Carney to testify to Parliament on oceans role
summary: The Conservatives are calling on Prime Minister Mark Carney's wife to testify to Parliament about her role as oceans envoy.

image.caption: Diana Fox Carney was appointed the federal oceans envoy, a new role, earlier this year. (Christophe Ena/The Associated Press)

blocks.text: The Conservatives are calling on Prime Minister Mark Carney's wife to testify to Parliament about her role as oceans envoy.
Party to move motion requesting Carney appear to explain her mandate
· Posted: Nov 26, 2026 2:46 PM EST | Last Updated: 13 minutes ago
The party says it will move a motion at the House environment committee requesting that Diana Fox Carney appear before the committee to explain her mandate.

In September, Carney's cabinet appointed Fox Carney as Canada's first oceans envoy and tasked her with connecting ocean conservation, climate action, Indigenous leadership, economic resilience and maritime security.
The Conservatives say Canadians should know more about her priorities, what authority she has been given to shape policy and how her staffing and travel are funded.

blocks.text: The role already has taken Fox Carney to Iqaluit and she will chair a major conference in Halifax next spring.
Prime Minister Carney's office has said the role is not in conflict with federal ethics rules.
